name: Swearing And Cursing
overview: Scripture clearly forbids taking the name of the Lord in vain, warning that God will not hold guiltless those who misuse His name (Exodus 20:7). The heart’s condition is revealed through speech, as Jesus teaches that evil words defile a person more than what enters the mouth (Matthew 15:11; 12:34). Believers are called to guard their tongues against perverse and harmful speech, avoiding anger and insults that bring judgment, such as calling a brother 'Raca' or 'fool' (Matthew 5:22; Proverbs 4:24). Additionally, Jesus affirms the importance of truthfulness in oaths, instructing that one must fulfill promises made to the Lord (Matthew 5:33).
